description: Fix broken Tailwind CSS 4 utility classes and missing design tokens. Multiple classes used in components do not generate CSS output because they are not registered in the @theme inline block in tokens.css, or because the animations/utilities they reference are not defined anywhere.
steps: 1. Register the 'stardust' color in the @theme inline block in src/styles/tokens.css. Add: --color-stardust: #4DC8F5; (this value comes from the dead tailwind.config.js). This will enable bg-stardust/20, bg-stardust/15, bg-stardust/10 to generate CSS.

2. Add the missing --duration-fast CSS variable to the :root block in src/styles/tokens.css (motion tokens section). Set it to 120ms to match the existing --duration-quick pattern. This fixes --analysis-duration-fast: var(--duration-fast) which currently resolves to nothing.

3. Define a @keyframes blob animation in src/styles/motion.css. The blob animation should be a slow, organic movement (scale + translate) suitable for ambient background blobs. Define it as: @keyframes blob { 0%,100% { transform: translate(0,0) scale(1); } 33% { transform: translate(30px,-50px) scale(1.1); } 66% { transform: translate(-20px,20px) scale(0.9); } }
4. Add a .animate-blob utility class in the ANIMATION UTILITY CLASSES section of src/styles/motion.css: .animate-blob { animation: blob 7s infinite; }
5. Add animation-delay utility classes in src/styles/motion.css: .animation-delay-2000 { animation-delay: 2s; } .animation-delay-4000 { animation-delay: 4s; }

6. Wrap the new .animate-blob, .animation-delay-2000, .animation-delay-4000 in a @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) {} block OR ensure the existing prefers-reduced-motion:reduce rule at the bottom of motion.css already covers them (it does, since it blankets all animations to 0.01ms).

7. Delete the dead config/tailwind.config.js file. It is not loaded by TW4 (no @config directive), confuses contributors, and its color definitions conflict with what @theme inline actually provides. Update config/knip.json if it references this file.
acceptance_criteria: Running 'pnpm run build' produces bg-stardust classes in the output CSS (grep dist/assets/*.css for 'stardust' finds matches)
Running 'pnpm run build' produces animate-blob, animation-delay-2000, animation-delay-4000 in the output CSS
The --duration-fast variable is defined in :root and analysis tokens resolve correctly
The blob keyframes animation is defined in the output CSS
pnpm run build succeeds without errors
pnpm run test passes (same as before, 1 pre-existing failure in sound.test.ts is acceptable)
findings: All acceptance criteria verified. Build succeeds. CSS output contains stardust color utilities (bg-stardust, bg-stardust/10, bg-stardust/15, bg-stardust/20), blob keyframes, animate-blob class, and animation-delay utilities. Tests pass with only the pre-existing sound.test.ts failure. knip.json only references 'tailwindcss' as an ignoredDependency (the npm package), not the config file path, so no update was needed there.
